intent: Build a full booking system web app for a barbershop: services, staff schedules, time-slot booking, admin view, and email-style confirmations.

spec.goal: Get a web app that lets a barbershop's customers book appointments and lets the shop manage services, staff schedules and bookings.
spec.deliverable: A working booking system web app for a barbershop with a service list, staff schedules, time-slot booking, an admin view, and email-style booking confirmations.
constraints: Must include a list of services that customers can choose from.
Must include staff schedules that determine which time slots are available.
Must include an admin view for managing the shop's bookings, services and schedules.
Confirmations should be email-style messages shown or generated after a booking; no other notification channels or integrations are requested.
Must not include features beyond those listed (e.g. payments) since the request does not mention them.
done_criteria: A customer can choose a service and book an available time slot with a staff member.
Available time slots reflect staff schedules, and a booked slot cannot be booked again.
An admin view lets the shop see and manage bookings, services and staff schedules.
After booking, an email-style confirmation with the booking details is produced.
spec.summary: You want a complete barbershop booking web app where customers pick a service and a time slot based on staff schedules, receive an email-style confirmation, and the shop can manage everything in an admin view.
